deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds an unstated link by stating that the slice through a tumour illustrates explanting the tumour ('illustrates this [FIGURE]'). The lecturer only described what the figure shows ('Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology') without stating that it illustrates tumour explantation.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: The word 'really' functions as an intensifier in spoken English rather than an epistemic hedge, so rendering the statement as 'Primary cells do not grow in culture' is an allowed stylistic simplification rather than the removal of a hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: So when HeLa cells, which were the first tumor cells to grow in culture, did that, this was very much a surprise.
considerations.reason: The rewrite restructures the clause into 'HeLa cells were the first tumour cells to grow in culture, and so this was very much a surprise', which preserves the core facts and the causal context established by the preceding sentence.

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: Omitted as an offhand remark to the audience and lecture meta-commentary, which is permitted.

considerations.sourcePassage: with regard to the contributions of things like the stroma and other things.
considerations.reason: Changing 'other things' to 'other components' is an acceptable stylistic choice that preserves the meaning.
